title: How to optimally prepare for interviews as an Aspiring Psychologist

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 各位心理学家，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间以外的钱，那会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性的收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要告诉大家。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现在开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己曾在2022年完成了这个项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖励，以及我提供的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四次小组智囊团会议、大师课、个性化指导、一份福特纳姆和梅森的礼品，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名截止日期为11月16日星期一晚上10点。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时为你解答。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你正寻求成为一名心理学家，那么让这成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: With this podcast at your side, you'll be on your way to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 有这个播客在身边，你将走上“有抱负的心理学家”播客之路。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听“有抱负的心理学家”播客。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening.
sentences.zh: 感谢你的收听。

sentences.en: So if you are listening to this podcast, then it's probably quite likely that you are aware
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你正在收听这个播客，那么很有可能你已经意识到

sentences.en: that certainly for clinical psychologists, application season at the time that I'm recording, which is January 2022, is in, you know, in part of its cycle, part of its lifespan.
sentences.zh: 对于临床心理学家来说，在我录制节目的当下，也就是2022年1月，申请季正处于其周期的一部分，生命周期的一部分。

sentences.en: So people are currently awaiting to find out if they are going to be offered interviews for the clinical doctorate.
sentences.zh: 所以人们目前正在等待，看自己是否会获得临床博士课程的面试机会。

sentences.en: And I would love some insider info about the life cycles, the application cycles of your particular discipline.
sentences.zh: 我很想了解一下你们各自学科的生命周期和申请周期的一些内部信息。

sentences.en: So if you're listening to this and you're thinking, well, ours isn't, you know, September until spring,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你正在听这个节目，并且心想，嗯，我们的不是从九月到春天，

sentences.en: then let me know, because it's obviously important that I'm providing content that feels useful for you, whatever discipline of psychology you are in.
sentences.zh: 那么请告诉我，因为显然我很重要的一点是提供对你有用的内容，无论你从事的是心理学的哪个学科。

sentences.en: So if you have a different time span, let me know and I can make sure that I'm putting stuff in my diary,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你有不同的时间跨度，请告诉我，我可以确保把这些记在我的日记里，

sentences.en: you know, planning content that's going to be useful for you at the time that you need it, because I don't want this to be just for aspiring clinical psychologists.
sentences.zh: 你知道，规划出在你需要时对你有用的内容，因为我不希望这仅仅是为了有抱负的临床心理学家准备的。

sentences.en: I want this to be useful for you, whatever your particular niche goal is in psychology.
sentences.zh: 我希望这对你有用，无论你在心理学领域的目标是什么。

sentences.en: And if you are awaiting the news about whether you are being invited for selection tests or for for interviews themselves, then, you know, oh, my heart goes out to you.
sentences.zh: 如果你正在等待关于是否被邀请参加选拔测试或面试的消息，那么，你知道，我真的很同情你。

sentences.en: It is tricky.
sentences.zh: 这确实很棘手。

sentences.en: And by the time this goes live, which is probably going to be February or March, you know, that that time will be all the more closer.
sentences.zh: 等到这期节目上线时，大概是二月或三月，你知道，那个时间会更近了。

sentences.en: And you might well be getting probably not letters these days when it be probably be interviews being communicated to you via email.
sentences.zh: 你很可能收到的不是信件，现在大概是通过电子邮件通知你面试。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I I remember anxiety.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我记得那种焦虑。

sentences.en: Well, the waiting, hoping, the wishing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，等待、希望、祈祷。

sentences.en: Yeah, you know, and reflecting on every word you've written in your form and thinking, you know, is it good enough?
sentences.zh: 是的，你知道，反思你在表格中写的每一个字，心想，这足够好吗？

sentences.en: Is it going to be OK?
sentences.zh: 这会没问题吗？

sentences.en: And even, you know, the experiences that you have in the days, weeks and months,
sentences.zh: 甚至，你知道，你在那些日子、几周和几个月里经历的事情，

sentences.en: even after you have clicked submit on that form, you're thinking, oh, this would have been great on the form.
sentences.zh: 即使在你点击提交表格之后，你也会想，哦，如果表格里写上这个就太棒了。

sentences.en: This would have been great.
sentences.zh: 这个会很棒的。

sentences.en: And let's hope that you don't need to reflect on that in future forMs.
sentences.zh: 希望你以后不需要在表格中反思这些。

sentences.en: But of course, it can take a number of attempts and beyond to to get to, you know,
sentences.zh: 但当然，可能需要多次尝试甚至更多才能达到，你知道，

sentences.en: and I was just talking to someone from The Express, actually a journalist to get to manifest what it is that we want, you know,
sentences.zh: 我刚才其实正在和《快报》的一位记者交谈，为了实现我们想要的东西，你知道，

sentences.en: and that's what we are trying to help you do in this podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们在这个播客中试图帮助你做的事情。

sentences.en: We're trying to help you to manifest your dreams, you know, and my stance.
sentences.zh: 我们试图帮助你实现梦想，你知道，还有我的立场。

sentences.en: You can probably Google it by the time by the time you're listening to this.
sentences.zh: 等你听到这期节目时，你可能已经可以在谷歌上搜到了。

sentences.en: But my stance on that is that, you know, by goal setting and being quite focused and determined around what it is that you would like to achieve,
sentences.zh: 但我对此的立场是，你知道，通过设定目标，并对你想要实现的目标保持专注和坚定，

sentences.en: it makes it a whole heap more likely that you're going to bring that goal to fruition.
sentences.zh: 这会让你实现目标的可能性大大增加。

sentences.en: You know, whether or not you want to add any crystals into the mix is entirely up to you.
sentences.zh: 你知道，无论你是否想在其中加入任何水晶，这完全取决于你。

sentences.en: And people who like manifesting often do like a bit of crystal healing and all of that jazz.
sentences.zh: 喜欢显化的人通常也喜欢一点水晶疗法之类的东西。

sentences.en: But, you know, by goal setting and tuning into the right podcasts, ones with jingles,
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，通过设定目标并收听正确的播客，那些有片头曲的，

sentences.en: you're going to make it more likely for yourself that you are able to achieve your dreams and achieve your goals.
sentences.zh: 你会让自己更有可能实现你的梦想和目标。

sentences.en: So that's my little take on what we are.
sentences.zh: 这就是我对我们所做之事的看法。

sentences.en: That's my little mission for this podcast, that this helps, you know,
sentences.zh: 这就是我这个播客的小小使命，希望这能有所帮助，你知道，

sentences.en: flavour the water that you swim in with, you know, qualified psychology opinion.
sentences.zh: 用合格的心理学观点来点缀你所处的环境。

sentences.en: And I hope that you're finding it useful.
sentences.zh: 我希望你觉得它很有用。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So I digress as I want to do.
sentences.zh: 所以我又离题了，这是我的习惯。

sentences.en: And I hope that you don't mind the fact that I digress because hopefully the stories are interesting along the way.
sentences.zh: 我希望你不介意我离题，因为希望这些故事在过程中很有趣。

sentences.en: If you don't like my digressing and you wish it was just pure psychology,
sentences.zh: 如果你不喜欢我离题，希望这只是纯粹的心理学，

sentences.en: then you might like to listen on double speed or, you know, maybe I'm not.
sentences.zh: 那么你可能想用双倍速度收听，或者，你知道，也许我不是。

sentences.en: Maybe I'm not your jam.
sentences.zh: 也许我不是你的菜。

sentences.en: I'm quoting Princess Poppy again.
sentences.zh: 我再次引用波比公主的话。

sentences.en: So when I was an aspiring clinical psychologist, I was having to wait for letters to drop through my letterbox to invite me for interview or to decline me from an interview.
sentences.zh: 所以当我还是一个有抱负的临床心理学家时，我不得不等待信件投递到我的信箱，邀请我面试或拒绝我面试。

sentences.en: And I remember the first time I was offered an interview for a doctorate course,
sentences.zh: 我记得第一次被邀请参加博士课程面试时，

sentences.en: I sat on the stairs at my parents' house and I ripped it open.
sentences.zh: 我坐在父母家的楼梯上，把它撕开了。

sentences.en: And the first thing I saw was a map and I was like, oh, my God, they don't send maps to people that they don't want to see.
sentences.zh: 我看到的第一件事是一张地图，我当时想，天哪，他们不会给不想见的人寄地图。

sentences.en: And so I just felt really excited from seeing that map.
sentences.zh: 所以看到那张地图我感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: And, you know, I think that's a bit of a sad thing about moving to online communication,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我认为转向在线交流是一件有点令人难过的事情，

sentences.en: because, you know, you'll know as soon as you open it, you know, there's no there's no how thick the envelope is to,
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道，你一打开就会知道，没有信封有多厚来，

sentences.en: you know, about how much information you're getting because you don't know how big the email is before you open it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，关于你收到了多少信息，因为在打开之前你不知道邮件有多大。

sentences.en: So, yeah, that's a that's a downer for modern technology, because when you've got a slightly fatter envelope, that felt pretty exciting.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这对现代技术来说是一个减分项，因为当你有一个稍微厚一点的信封时，感觉相当令人兴奋。

sentences.en: So, yeah, fond memories of that.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，对此有美好的回忆。

sentences.en: And I still have my letters offering me, I think, interviews on the course that I accepted.
sentences.zh: 我仍然保留着那些邀请我面试的信件，我想是我接受的那个课程的。

sentences.en: And I still definitely have my letters offering me places on both of the courses that I was offered, because that is, you know, really a significant milestone in my in my life.
sentences.zh: 我肯定还保留着那些邀请我入学的信件，因为那确实是我生命中一个重要的里程碑。

sentences.en: You know, you knowing me now like you do, you're probably like, did you buy a perfume?
sentences.zh: 你知道，像现在这样了解我，你可能会问，你买了香水吗？

sentences.en: Did you buy some shoes?
sentences.zh: 你买了鞋子吗？

sentences.en: No, I decided to go off traveling.
sentences.zh: 不，我决定去旅行。

sentences.en: Where did I go?
sentences.zh: 我去了哪里？

sentences.en: I went around India with one of my friends who was also getting onto a doctorate course.
sentences.zh: 我和我的一个也考上博士课程的朋友环游了印度。

sentences.en: And also before that, I went to Spain and Morocco.
sentences.zh: 在那之前，我还去了西班牙和摩洛哥。

sentences.en: So that's what I did.
sentences.zh: 这就是我所做的。

sentences.en: And I'm afraid the pandemic has squashed people's ability to be able to jet set as much as they did.
sentences.zh: 恐怕疫情已经扼杀了人们像以前那样到处飞的能力。

sentences.en: But once I knew that I was on the doctorate, I was making plans to jack my job in and to go and enjoy, you know,
sentences.zh: 但一旦我知道我被博士课程录取了，我就开始计划辞掉工作，去享受，你知道，

sentences.en: this stage of my life where I knew what the next stage was going to be and when it was going to start.
sentences.zh: 我生命中的这个阶段，我知道下一个阶段会是什么，以及它什么时候开始。

sentences.en: I do believe it started on September the 22nd.
sentences.zh: 我记得它是9月22日开始的。

sentences.en: So I just had to make sure I was back in the country for then.
sentences.zh: 所以我只需要确保在那之前回到国内。

sentences.en: And, you know, I did.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我做到了。

sentences.en: I think I got back from India on the Friday.
sentences.zh: 我想我是周五从印度回来的。

sentences.en: I had my leaving party on the Saturday.
sentences.zh: 周六我举办了离职派对。

sentences.en: I moved on the Sunday and my doctorate started on the Monday.
sentences.zh: 周日我搬了家，周一我的博士课程就开始了。

sentences.en: So I was, you know, not leaving any time for living my life unlived.
sentences.zh: 所以我没有留下任何时间去过未曾体验的生活。

sentences.en: But then that said, I loved my doctorate as well.
sentences.zh: 但话虽如此，我也热爱我的博士生涯。

sentences.en: So it wasn't like it was a question of, you know, putting my life on hold.
sentences.zh: 所以这并不是说要把我的生活搁置起来。

sentences.en: You know, I was committing myself to one locality for three years.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我把自己承诺给了一个地方三年。

sentences.en: But, you know, if you're listening to this, perhaps as a qualified psychologist or perhaps as an aspiring one or a trainee psychologist, and you're like, she loved her doctorate.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，如果你正在听这个节目，也许作为一名合格的心理学家，或者作为一名有抱负的心理学家或实习心理学家，你会想，她热爱她的博士生涯？

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: Then I say, yeah, I did.
sentences.zh: 那么我会说，是的，我确实热爱。

sentences.en: You know, I knew it would be tricky in parts and in parts it was.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我知道这在某些方面会很棘手，确实如此。

sentences.en: I knew I'd be signing up to work and study.
sentences.zh: 我知道我是在报名参加工作和学习。

sentences.en: I knew I'd be, you know, having lots of different demands.
sentences.zh: 我知道我会有很多不同的要求。

sentences.en: But for me, I didn't have children at that time.
sentences.zh: 但对我来说，那时我还没有孩子。

sentences.en: And I was single when I started the course.
sentences.zh: 我开始课程时是单身。

sentences.en: It was what I expected it to be.
sentences.zh: 这正如我所预期的那样。

sentences.en: And I had made space in my life to accommodate those three years.
sentences.zh: 我已经在生活中腾出了空间来适应那三年。

sentences.en: I didn't go into it thinking it was going to be effortless.
sentences.zh: 我并没有认为它会毫不费力。

sentences.en: And it wasn't.
sentences.zh: 事实也并非如此。

sentences.en: So I think sometimes going into things without eyes open can be really useful.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为有时睁大眼睛去面对事情真的很有用。

sentences.en: Once again, I've wobbled off.
sentences.zh: 再一次，我又跑题了。

sentences.en: I've digressed.
sentences.zh: 我又离题了。

sentences.en: So if you are waiting for your own application season to start, you might well be clicking and checking whether your references have been received.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你正在等待自己的申请季开始，你很可能会点击并检查你的推荐信是否已收到。

sentences.en: And if they still say no, then it might just be worth checking in with your referee.
sentences.zh: 如果它们仍然显示没有，那么去询问一下你的推荐人可能很值得。

sentences.en: It's always a good idea to check in with your referee before you submit to check that,
sentences.zh: 在提交之前与你的推荐人核实总是一个好主意，以确认，

sentences.en: A, they're not going off on some six months secondment or, you know, maternity or paternity leave.
sentences.zh: 第一，他们不会去进行为期六个月的借调，或者休产假或陪产假。

sentences.en: That their contact details haven't changed and that they are indeed happy to write you a reference.
sentences.zh: 他们的联系方式没有改变，而且他们确实乐意为你写推荐信。

sentences.en: So then if the reference hasn't been submitted or hasn't been received, you can just gently check in with them to explore,
sentences.zh: 所以如果推荐信还没有提交或没有收到，你可以轻轻地询问他们，探讨一下，

sentences.en: whether they have been able to do that for you or whether, you know, whether they need some more time or some more,
sentences.zh: 他们是否已经为你完成了，或者，你知道，他们是否需要更多时间，或者更多，

sentences.en: I don't know, more something from you or maybe they just need a little, a little jig.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，需要你提供更多东西，或者也许他们只是需要一点点提醒。

sentences.en: Maybe the reference request is are just sitting in, you know, in spam folder or something and they've not seen it.
sentences.zh: 也许推荐请求只是躺在垃圾邮件文件夹里，他们没看到。

sentences.en: So with you gently getting in contact to probe, you know, it might make that come to fruition that bit quicker.
sentences.zh: 所以通过你轻轻地联系去探询，这可能会让事情更快地实现。

sentences.en: I, in the days of the Stone Ages, used to wait for my own little stamped addressed envelope to arrive that said references received.
sentences.zh: 在石器时代，我曾经等待我自己的贴好邮票的信封到达，上面写着推荐信已收到。

sentences.en: So the course would send those out or Clearinghouse would send those out at my own cost of a stamp, stamped addressed envelopes, we called them in the day.
sentences.zh: 所以课程会寄出这些，或者清算所会寄出这些，费用由我承担，我们当时称之为贴好邮票的信封。

sentences.en: Yeah, to let me know that A, my application had been received.
sentences.zh: 是的，让我知道第一，我的申请已经收到。

sentences.en: That's a happy one to receive.
sentences.zh: 收到这个很高兴。

sentences.en: Although I knew because I'd already stalked it on Royal Mail.
sentences.zh: 虽然我知道，因为我已经通过皇家邮政追踪过了。

sentences.en: And B, that references had been received.
sentences.zh: 第二，推荐信已经收到。

sentences.en: And then it was like, OK, we are good to go.
sentences.zh: 然后就像是，好的，我们可以开始了。

sentences.en: So let's just wait and see and hope and wish.
sentences.zh: 所以让我们拭目以待，希望和祈祷吧。

sentences.en: OK, so a useful piece of advice here is when you and if you hopefully are called to interview,
sentences.zh: 好的，这里有一个有用的建议，当你如果幸运地被邀请面试时，

sentences.en: it can be a really good idea to look at your own application, to look what you submitted.
sentences.zh: 看看你自己的申请，看看你提交了什么，这可能是一个非常好的主意。

sentences.en: And any bits that make you cringe a bit, you know, maybe you're thinking, I might slightly have padded out my own expertise and knowledge in that area.
sentences.zh: 任何让你感到有点尴尬的部分，你知道，也许你在想，我可能稍微夸大了我在那个领域的专业知识和知识。

sentences.en: It's a good chance for you to be able to try and thicken that dialogue a little bit between now and your interview date.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很好的机会，让你在面试日期之前尝试加强那部分的对话。

sentences.en: For any of you watching The Apprentice, I do believe I've watched every single series and every single episode.
sentences.zh: 对于任何观看《学徒》的人，我相信我已经看了每一季和每一集。

sentences.en: I, yeah, I just love it.
sentences.zh: 我，是的，我就是喜欢它。

sentences.en: You know, we all know that the most cringeworthy episodes are the interview ones where their CVs are turned over
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们都知道最令人尴尬的剧集是面试那一集，他们的简历被翻出来，

sentences.en: and they've got in contact with people and, you know, they've been ousted as actually having not done some of the things they've claimed to have done
sentences.zh: 他们联系了相关人员，你知道，他们被揭露实际上并没有做过他们声称做过的一些事情，

sentences.en: or they've bigged up their part and it's just horrifying.
sentences.zh: 或者他们夸大了自己的部分，这简直太可怕了。

sentences.en: So just try to make sure that what you've put on your form, in retrospect, in hindsight, is factually correct as possible.
sentences.zh: 所以尽量确保你在表格上写的内容，回顾起来，事后看来，尽可能在事实上是正确的。

sentences.en: And I don't know of anyone who goes to the extent that Lord Sugar and his team do.
sentences.zh: 我不知道有谁会像舒格勋爵和他的团队那样去核实。

sentences.en: But, yeah, just have a look over what you've submitted because, of course, that's what you've been invited on the basis of.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，看看你提交的内容，因为当然，这就是你被邀请的基础。

sentences.en: OK, so once you've had a look at what you've said, if you do feel like there's any weaknesses, any drawbacks that you feel might be your Achilles heel,
sentences.zh: 好的，所以一旦你看过你所说的，如果你确实觉得有任何弱点，任何你觉得可能是你阿喀琉斯之踵的缺点，

sentences.en: then, like I said, it's your chance to, you know, to get as much experience so that it doesn't feel like you're going into that interview with an Achilles heel.
sentences.zh: 那么，就像我说的，这是你的机会，你知道，去获得尽可能多的经验，这样你就不会觉得你是带着阿喀琉斯之踵去参加面试的。

sentences.en: We all will have Achilles heels.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都会有阿喀琉斯之踵。

sentences.en: We might not know what they are until they ask us the question.
sentences.zh: 在他们问我们问题之前，我们可能不知道它们是什么。

sentences.en: And then we're like, oh, man, I have no clue.
sentences.zh: 然后我们会想，哦，天哪，我毫无头绪。

sentences.en: Just take a breath.
sentences.zh: 深呼吸一下。

sentences.en: Just take a pause.
sentences.zh: 停顿一下。

sentences.en: You can always ask for a moment as you feel like your world is imploding and there's tumbleweed and crickets.
sentences.zh: 当你觉得你的世界正在崩溃，周围一片死寂时，你总是可以要求片刻时间。

sentences.en: You can always ask for a little more time, you know, and you can always ask for them to repeat the question again because what we know is when we are in a, you know,
sentences.zh: 你总是可以要求更多时间，你知道，你总是可以要求他们再重复一遍问题，因为我们知道，当我们处于，你知道，

sentences.en: excited forward slash agitated anxious state that the top part of our brain might go offline a little bit.
sentences.zh: 兴奋或激动焦虑的状态时，我们大脑的顶层可能会稍微离线。

sentences.en: So taking those breaths can be really useful and just encouraging yourself to calm down.
sentences.zh: 所以深呼吸真的很有用，鼓励自己冷静下来。

sentences.en: And it's OK to ask for the question again.
sentences.zh: 要求再问一遍问题是可以的。

sentences.en: OK, so you might find it helpful to go through in supervision your form if that is the kind of relationship you have with your supervisor
sentences.zh: 好的，如果你有那种督导关系，在督导中过一遍你的表格可能会有帮助，

sentences.en: and to, you know, to think about any questions that crop up for them.
sentences.zh: 并且，你知道，去思考对他们来说出现的任何问题。

sentences.en: Yeah, they might already have read your form anyway.
sentences.zh: 没错，反正他们可能已经读过你的申请表了。

sentences.en: If they haven't, then it might be useful if you can bear it, if you can tolerate it to explore some of that in supervision.
sentences.zh: 如果还没读过，那么如果你能承受、能忍受的话，在督导中探讨一下这些内容可能会有所帮助。

sentences.en: And your next port of call will be for whatever job you're applying for, be it, you know, an assistant psychologist post or a research psychologist post
sentences.zh: 你接下来的目标将是你申请的任何工作，无论是助理心理学家职位还是研究心理学家职位，

sentences.en: or indeed one of the clinical doctorate courses or your own, you know, qualified specialty route.
sentences.zh: 当然，也可能是临床博士课程，或者是你自己的专业资格认证途径。

sentences.en: Then you need to be looking at the job description, you know.
sentences.zh: 所以你需要仔细研究职位描述。

sentences.en: So it might be an idea to look at what the course themselves are saying about their program.
sentences.zh: 因此，去看看课程项目方自己对课程的介绍也是个好主意。

sentences.en: If you are an aspiring clinical psychologist, it might be useful for you to get yourself a copy of the alternative handbook
sentences.zh: 如果你立志成为一名临床心理学家，获取一份《另类手册》（Alternative Handbook）可能会对你很有帮助，

sentences.en: to look at what the other trainees on the course are saying about the course.
sentences.zh: 你可以看看该课程的其他学员对课程的评价。

sentences.en: And if you are applying for an NHS job, then there'll always be a person description and, of course, a job description.
sentences.zh: 如果你申请的是英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）的工作，那么肯定会有个人说明和职位描述。

sentences.en: So make sure that you know what they're asking for, because they could ask, you know, about any of those things.
sentences.zh: 所以一定要确保你了解他们提出的要求，因为他们可能会问到其中任何一项内容。

sentences.en: And I'm obviously in this podcast, I'm not going to be giving
sentences.zh: 显然，在这个播客里，我不会提供

sentences.en: any past examples of questions because that's not really appropriate, I don't feel.
sentences.zh: 任何过往的面试题示例，因为我觉得这不太合适。

sentences.en: And so, yeah, if you were tuning in hoping that that's what I was going to do, then sorry, spoiler alert, that's not going to be here.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你是抱着这种期待来收听的，那很抱歉，剧透一下，这里不会有这些内容。

sentences.en: I'm sure if you Googled some, some would come up.
sentences.zh: 我相信如果你去谷歌搜索一下，肯定能找到一些。

sentences.en: But, yeah, it doesn't feel particularly fair for me to do that.
sentences.zh: 但是，我觉得这样做不太公平。

sentences.en: And, of course, with my knowledge of the two clinical doctorate interviews that I've been, it, yeah, it wouldn't feel particularly fair to broadcast that
sentences.zh: 当然，基于我参加过的两次临床博士面试的经验，我觉得把这些内容广播出去不太公平，

sentences.en: in case they're still using the same sort of questions.
sentences.zh: 万一他们还在使用同样的面试题呢。

sentences.en: It just wouldn't feel, it wouldn't feel like it was particularly fair.
sentences.zh: 这感觉不太公平，真的不太公平。

sentences.en: It would be like giving you the exam questions before the exam.
sentences.zh: 这就好比在考试前把考题泄露给你一样。

sentences.en: So I'm sorry, I'm not going to do that.
sentences.zh: 所以我很抱歉，我不会那样做。

sentences.en: But I want you to do your best and to be your optimal best self
sentences.zh: 但我希望你能尽力而为，展现出最佳的自己，

sentences.en: and to have to scrabble in a session like I probably did, you know, with those tumbleweed moments, but managing your own physiology enough
sentences.zh: 虽然在面试中可能会像我当年那样，偶尔出现冷场，但只要你能控制好自己的生理状态，

sentences.en: to be able to get through it and to pull the rabbit out of the hat and get yourself that job.
sentences.zh: 就足以应对过去，像变魔术一样拿出精彩表现，从而获得那份工作。

sentences.en: So those are our basic checks to make.
sentences.zh: 以上就是我们需要做的基本检查。

sentences.en: It can be also helpful to Google the names of anyone that you know who's going to be interviewing you so that you can read any research
sentences.zh: 谷歌搜索一下面试官的名字也很有帮助，这样你可以阅读他们最近发表的研究，

sentences.en: that they might have done recently or to see what service they work in and kind of the way that their service operates.
sentences.zh: 或者了解他们所在的服务部门以及该部门的运作方式。

sentences.en: If you are applying for a specific trust, then it can be useful to Google whether there's any trust values that are around for your truSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你申请的是特定的信托机构（Trust），那么搜索一下该机构是否有相关的核心价值观会很有用。

sentences.en: So they might be things like, you know, compassion in action, respect for everybody, you know, safety.
sentences.zh: 这些价值观可能包括：以同理心行事、尊重每一个人、安全等等。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我也不确定。

sentences.en: It differs between trusts.
sentences.zh: 不同信托机构之间会有所不同。

sentences.en: But if you know a specific trust, not so much for clinical interviews because it's not the trust that they're interviewing you.
sentences.zh: 但如果你了解特定的信托机构，这对于临床面试来说可能没那么重要，因为面试你的并不是信托机构本身。

sentences.en: It's usually academic staff and clinical staff from the locality.
sentences.zh: 面试官通常是来自当地的学术人员和临床工作人员。

sentences.en: So, you know, it might be that actually on some doctorate courses that there is a representative from the trust who's going to be employing you.
sentences.zh: 当然，有些博士课程可能会有雇佣你的信托机构代表参加面试。

sentences.en: But to my knowledge, I'm not familiar with that.
sentences.zh: 但据我所知，我不太熟悉这种情况。

sentences.en: So if actually that is the case, let me know and I can make sure that we'll reflect that in future.
sentences.zh: 如果确实有这种情况，请告诉我，我可以确保在未来的节目中反映出来。

sentences.en: So, yeah, perhaps if you're going on to a PWP or an assistant psychologist or some other kind of related job, you know, support worker,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你申请的是心理健康从业者（PWP）、助理心理学家或其他相关工作，比如支持工作者，

sentences.en: and you're going to be looking at trust values, then it can be really useful to make sure that in every answer you give that you're weaving in, you know, a trust value as well.
sentences.zh: 并且你需要关注信托机构的价值观，那么在回答每一个问题时，巧妙地融入这些价值观会非常有用。

sentences.en: So if they're asking something about confidentiality, then you could give, you know, your usual patter about what confidentiality is and why it's important.
sentences.zh: 比如，如果他们问到保密原则，你可以给出你通常的解释，说明什么是保密以及为什么它很重要。

sentences.en: You could give a little case vignette about where you've used confidentiality or how you've explained it.
sentences.zh: 你可以举一个小案例，说明你在哪里运用了保密原则，或者你是如何向他人解释的。

sentences.en: And then you could, you know, weave in a relevant trust value of, I don't know, respect for everyone and, you know, clinical excellence or, you know, whatever the trust values are.
sentences.zh: 然后，你可以顺势融入一个相关的信托价值观，比如“尊重每一个人”或“临床卓越”等等，具体取决于该机构的价值观。

sentences.en: But you need to be making sure you're giving a values-based interview.
sentences.zh: 但你需要确保你的面试是基于价值观的。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I hope that is useful.
sentences.zh: 希望这些建议对你有用。

sentences.en: Always look out for who is employing you and what is important to them and try and quote it back to them in interview because that's going to help you stand out.
sentences.zh: 一定要关注是谁在雇佣你，什么对他们来说很重要，并尝试在面试中引用这些内容，因为这会让你脱颖而出。

sentences.en: And the same is true, of course, for the clinical courses.
sentences.zh: 当然，临床课程也是如此。

sentences.en: If they are specialising in, you know, CBT, then it makes sense to be mentioning CBT.
sentences.zh: 如果他们专注于认知行为疗法（CBT），那么提到CBT就很有意义。

sentences.en: If they are really dynamic or systemic or, you know, any other kind of discipline, then it makes sense that you talk the talk and walk the walk.
sentences.zh: 如果他们非常推崇动力学、系统疗法或其他任何学科，那么言行一致就显得非常重要。

sentences.en: Okay, I'm just going to take a short break and I will be back to think with you more about interviews.
sentences.zh: 好了，我先休息一下，稍后回来继续和大家探讨面试的话题。

sentences.en: Hold fire and I'll look forward to speaking to you very soon.
sentences.zh: 请稍等，期待很快与大家再次交流。

sentences.en: My name is Diakalola Amujam.
sentences.zh: 我叫Diakalola Amujam。

sentences.en: I am a recent psychology graduate from Ireland.
sentences.zh: 我是一名刚从爱尔兰毕业的心理学学生。

sentences.en: I am also an aspiring clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我也是一名立志成为临床心理学家的人。

sentences.en: Dr. Marion's book, The Clinical Psychologist Collective, has been so helpful to me on this journey to becoming a clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: Marion博士的书《临床心理学家集体》（The Clinical Psychologist Collective）在我成为临床心理学家的旅程中给了我很大帮助。

sentences.en: As I plan to continue postgraduate studies in the UK, I found it extremely useful that this book provided in-depth information on the UK de-ClinSci application process.
sentences.zh: 由于我计划在英国继续深造，我发现这本书提供了关于英国临床心理学博士（DClinSci）申请流程的详尽信息，这对我极其有用。

sentences.en: I enjoyed reading about the experiences of both qualified and training clinical psychologists.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢阅读那些已获得资格的心理学家和在读学员的经历。

sentences.en: The various narratives were my favourite part of the book, as everyone's story was different and it provided amazing insights into the clinical psychology journey.
sentences.zh: 各种各样的叙述是我最喜欢的部分，因为每个人的故事都不同，这让我对临床心理学之路有了惊人的洞察。

sentences.en: I would definitely recommend this book to anyone interested in psychology and aspires to become a clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我绝对会向任何对心理学感兴趣并立志成为临床心理学家的人推荐这本书。

sentences.en: Okay, welcome back.
sentences.zh: 好了，欢迎回来。

sentences.en: So, like I said, at the time of recording, it's January 2022 and we are most definitely still in pandemic season, aren't we?
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，录制这期节目时是2022年1月，我们显然仍处于疫情期间，不是吗？

sentences.en: And so certainly for 2020 and 2021, application and interview seasons looked a little different.
sentences.zh: 因此，2020年和2021年的申请和面试季看起来确实有些不同。

sentences.en: They looked a bit like homeworking, didn't they?
sentences.zh: 看起来有点像居家办公，对吧？

sentences.en: You know, quite often they took place via Zoom.
sentences.zh: 很多时候面试是通过Zoom进行的。

sentences.en: Maybe they might have been shorter than would have been ideally and it might mean that you don't see anyone who is also an aspiring psychologist during the interview process.
sentences.zh: 面试时间可能比理想情况要短，这意味着你在面试过程中可能见不到其他同样立志成为心理学家的人。

sentences.en: It might just be you and the academic staff and you and the clinical staff.
sentences.zh: 可能只有你和学术人员，或者你和临床工作人员。

sentences.en: Whereas actually, you know, a key part of the experience for me was sitting, you know, with however many people there were on the day in the waiting room and lunching together.
sentences.zh: 而实际上，对我来说，面试体验的关键部分是和当天其他面试者一起坐在候诊室里，一起吃午饭。

sentences.en: So for me, oh, you know when you do online training at home on Zoom, it's not the same, is it?
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，你知道在家通过Zoom进行在线培训时，感觉是不一样的，对吧？

sentences.en: Because you don't get the snacks, you don't get the lunch.
sentences.zh: 因为没有零食，也没有午餐。

sentences.en: And so if I was applying for a job, I would make sure that I bought myself, you know, an aspiring psychologist lunch.
sentences.zh: 所以如果是我申请工作，我会确保给自己准备一份“准心理学家午餐”。

sentences.en: That's totally what I would do to make sure that I felt like, you know, yeah, I'm treating myself nicely here, but also gearing myself up to perform optimally.
sentences.zh: 我绝对会这么做，以确保我感觉自己受到了很好的照顾，同时也为最佳表现做好准备。

sentences.en: So in making sure it's not something that's going to make me really sluggish all afternoon, you know, and, you know, it's going to be ready for me to be able to grab it
sentences.zh: 所以要确保午餐不会让我整个下午都昏昏欲睡，而且要确保我能随时拿来吃，

sentences.en: and eat it when I'm ready to eat it.
sentences.zh: 在我准备好进食的时候就能吃上。

sentences.en: So, oh, I can't stand fridge cold sandwiches.
sentences.zh: 我实在受不了冰箱里拿出来的冷三明治。

sentences.en: So I'd probably have to text my husband and say, take my sandwich out of the fridge or whatever I was eating or a salad so that it wasn't too cold.
sentences.zh: 所以我可能会给丈夫发短信，让他把我的三明治或沙拉从冰箱里拿出来，这样就不会太冷了。

sentences.en: But can you take care of yourself on interview day or maybe have someone else take care of you, your catering needs, to look after you?
sentences.zh: 那么，在面试当天，你能照顾好自己吗？或者让别人帮你打理餐饮需求，照顾好你？

sentences.en: Because it's a really stressful process because it really matters.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个压力很大的过程，因为它真的很重要。

sentences.en: You know, if you are striving to be a psychologist, then you're not doing this for kicks, you know.
sentences.zh: 如果你努力想成为一名心理学家，那你不是为了好玩才做这件事的，你知道的。

sentences.en: You're doing this because it matters to you.
sentences.zh: 你做这件事是因为它对你很重要。

sentences.en: And so, yeah, can you help get someone else on board to look after you and to, you know, to make sure that you're fed and watered in a way that really helps you to thrive?
sentences.zh: 所以，你能找人帮你照顾自己，确保你吃好喝好，以一种真正有助于你发挥的方式来应对吗？

sentences.en: And if there isn't someone, then you can do that for yourself, you know.
sentences.zh: 如果没有人帮忙，那你也可以自己照顾自己。

sentences.en: And maybe by the time we are, you know, in applications, whenever it is that you're listening to this episode, that face-to-face interviews are back on the agenda,
sentences.zh: 也许当你听到这期节目时，我们已经恢复了面对面的面试，

sentences.en: in which case I hope that they are still doing drinks, refreshments and lunch because that is just the highlight for me.
sentences.zh: 如果是那样的话，我希望他们还能提供饮料、茶点和午餐，因为那对我来说简直是亮点。

sentences.en: That's like a bonus.
sentences.zh: 那就像是额外奖励。

sentences.en: You get a free lunch and an interview.
sentences.zh: 你既能免费吃顿午餐，又能参加面试。

sentences.en: Yeah, so, yeah, bring on the snacks.
sentences.zh: 没错，多来点零食吧。

sentences.en: I'm all about the snacks and the drinks.
sentences.zh: 我可是零食和饮料的忠实粉丝。

sentences.en: And actually, one of the ways I chose between which clinical course to accept was because one of them had given me a choice of herbal teas at interview day
sentences.zh: 事实上，我选择接受哪门临床课程的原因之一，就是其中一门课程在面试当天为我提供了多种花草茶选择，

sentences.en: and I just thought, these are my people.
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，这就是我要找的组织。

sentences.en: These are my people.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的同道中人。

sentences.en: Whereas I think in the other one, there was just black tea or coffee and I was like, I don't drink either of those.
sentences.zh: 而另一门课程只提供红茶或咖啡，我当时就想，这两样我都不喝。

sentences.en: So, it clearly wasn't the only reason, but it was certainly, you know, on my list of pros of the course that I eventually picked, you know.
sentences.zh: 所以，这显然不是唯一的原因，但它确实列在我最终选择的那门课程的优点清单上。

sentences.en: Selection of herbal teas.
sentences.zh: 花草茶选择。

sentences.en: Check.
sentences.zh: 满分。

sentences.en: So, if I was having interviews at home,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我在家参加面试，

sentences.en: I'd be making sure that the environment I was in was also kind of aspirational and kind of nice.
sentences.zh: 我会确保我所处的环境也是积极向上且舒适的。

sentences.en: So, I might be lighting my favourite scented candle.
sentences.zh: 我可能会点上我最喜欢的香薰蜡烛。

sentences.en: I might be making sure that I was, you know, dressed properly for an interview, not just from the waist up.
sentences.zh: 我会确保我为面试穿戴整齐，不仅仅是腰部以上。

sentences.en: So, I'd probably make sure that I had an outfit where I felt like a trainee psychologist, you know.
sentences.zh: 我会穿上一套让我感觉自己像个心理学实习生的衣服。

sentences.en: So, I'm trying that outfit on for size.
sentences.zh: 我在试穿这套“心理学家”的行头。

sentences.en: Or I felt successful or worthwhile.
sentences.zh: 或者让我感觉自己很成功、很有价值。

sentences.en: So, of course, I probably would be a little bit smarter for an interview than I would be for, you know, a day on placement, for example.
sentences.zh: 当然，面试时的穿着肯定会比平时实习时稍微正式一点。

sentences.en: But I'd want something that helped me psychologically get on board with the fact that this was a really important interview day.
sentences.zh: 但我想要那种能从心理上让我进入状态的衣服，提醒我今天是一个非常重要的面试日。

sentences.en: This wasn't just me sitting in my slippers and in my joggers, okay.
sentences.zh: 这可不是让我穿着拖鞋和慢跑裤随便坐坐的场合。

sentences.en: So, for me, that's how I would make sure that I was in interview mode all day.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，这就是我确保整天都处于面试模式的方法。

sentences.en: I'd probably wear my shoes in the house on that occasion.
sentences.zh: 在那一天，我可能会在家里穿上我的皮鞋。

sentences.en: I took my kids to the cinema recently and in the back of the car, my eldest said to me,
sentences.zh: 我最近带孩子们去电影院，在车后座，我的大儿子对我说，

sentences.en: Mummy, I'm looking forward to going into the cinema because it makes me feel like a millionaire.
sentences.zh: “妈妈，我很期待去电影院，因为那让我感觉自己像个百万富翁。”

sentences.en: And I said, Oh, what do you mean?
sentences.zh: 我说：“哦，什么意思？”

sentences.en: And he said, Well, because I wear my shoes on the carpet.
sentences.zh: 他说：“因为我穿着鞋子走在地毯上。”

sentences.en: And I was like, Oh, what do you mean?
sentences.zh: 我说：“哦，什么意思？”

sentences.en: Because I make you take your shoes off at home?
sentences.zh: “是因为我在家里让你脱鞋吗？”

sentences.en: And he said, Yes.
sentences.zh: 他说：“是的。”

sentences.en: But when we watch old episodes of Topsy and Tim and stuff, they wear their shoes all over the sofa, like on their beds.
sentences.zh: “但是当我们看《Topsy and Tim》的老剧集时，他们穿着鞋子在沙发上走来走去，甚至在床上也是。”

sentences.en: And my kids are like appalled with that.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子们对此感到震惊。

sentences.en: They're like, Mummy, why have they got their shoes on on the sofa?
sentences.zh: 他们会说：“妈妈，为什么他们穿着鞋子在沙发上？”

sentences.en: And I'm like, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我说：“我不知道。”

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: “我不知道。”

sentences.en: So, yeah, I would be breaking my own rules on interview day or getting myself some new shoes.
sentences.zh: 所以，面试那天我会打破自己的规矩，或者去买双新鞋。

sentences.en: So New Year's Eve, I dressed up as Dorothy from The Wizard of Oz and I did wear shoes in the house.
sentences.zh: 新年前夜，我打扮成《绿野仙踪》里的多萝西，我在家里穿了鞋子。

sentences.en: But they were red ones and they'd never been worn outside.
sentences.zh: 那是双红色的鞋子，而且从来没在外面穿过。

sentences.en: So that helped me feel that it was OK.
sentences.zh: 这让我感觉一切都很好。

sentences.en: And I probably didn't go on the carpet with them.
sentences.zh: 而且我可能没穿它们走在地毯上。

sentences.en: I probably just stayed on the hard floor.
sentences.zh: 我可能只是待在硬地板上。

sentences.en: So, yeah, do you have your own weird little rules about shoe wearing in the house?
sentences.zh: 所以，你对在家里穿鞋有什么奇怪的小规矩吗？

sentences.en: Whatever is OK for you is OK for you.
sentences.zh: 无论你觉得什么样合适，那就合适。

sentences.en: But if you ever come run my house, please take your shoes off.
sentences.zh: 但如果你来我家，请务必脱鞋。

sentences.en: So, yeah, wear your shoes on your carpet on the day of your interview because it will make you feel like a millionaire.
sentences.zh: 所以，面试那天就在地毯上穿上你的鞋子吧，因为那会让你感觉像个百万富翁。

sentences.en: And that's direct from my eight-year-old.
sentences.zh: 这是我八岁儿子的原话。

sentences.en: Who doesn't want to feel like a millionaire on the day of their interview?
sentences.zh: 谁不想在面试那天感觉自己像个百万富翁呢？

sentences.en: So we need to be turning our phone off, not just on silent.
sentences.zh: 所以我们需要关掉手机，不仅仅是静音。

sentences.en: So I was just distracted for a moment there because my watch buzzed.
sentences.zh: 刚才我分心了一会儿，因为我的手表震动了。

sentences.en: You know, it told me to move my bum.
sentences.zh: 它提醒我该动动屁股了。

sentences.en: So maybe turn that function off and make sure that your phone's off.
sentences.zh: 所以也许关掉那个功能，确保手机彻底关机。

sentences.en: And if you've got a dog, maybe it's a good idea to see if anyone can look after the dog for the day so that you're not having to worry about walking the dog.
sentences.zh: 如果你有狗，找人帮忙照顾一天可能是不错的主意，这样你就不用担心遛狗的问题了。

sentences.en: You can still walk yourself.
sentences.zh: 你当然还是可以自己去散步。

sentences.en: You can still do that on breaks.
sentences.zh: 休息时依然可以这样做。

sentences.en: But you don't want to have to be worrying about the dog barking or distracting you.
sentences.zh: 但你肯定不想因为担心狗叫而分心。

sentences.en: So if you are at the front of the house, then it might be a good idea to draw the curtain so that you're not distracted by the postman.
sentences.zh: 如果你坐在房子前部，拉上窗帘可能是不错的主意，这样你就不会被邮递员分散注意力。

sentences.en: And it might be helpful to, you know, we've all got deliveries arriving all the time these days.
sentences.zh: 而且，我们现在总是不断收到快递，所以提前做好准备可能很有帮助。

sentences.en: So it might be helpful to see if you've got someone else on call or put a note on your door sending any deliveries to your neighbour if you've got one.
sentences.zh: 如果可以的话，找人代收快递，或者在门上贴个条，让快递员把包裹送到邻居家。

sentences.en: You need to make sure that you are adequately hydrated.
sentences.zh: 你需要确保自己水分充足。

sentences.en: It can be useful to have, you know, a glass of water with you in the interview.
sentences.zh: 面试时身边放一杯水可能很有用。

sentences.en: But of course, we do have a tendency as humans to use drinks as safety-seeking behaviours.
sentences.zh: 但当然，作为人类，我们倾向于把喝水当作一种寻求安全感的行为。

sentences.en: And this was something that we observed in our professional personal development group at my own training is that people would tend to use having a slurp of their drink
sentences.zh: 这是我们在专业个人发展小组培训中观察到的现象，人们往往会通过喝水来

sentences.en: to pause for time and deflect questions.
sentences.zh: 争取思考时间并回避问题。

sentences.en: So, you know, I would probably nowadays just try and own that a bit more and pause and take a breath
sentences.zh: 所以，现在我可能会尝试更坦诚地面对这一点，停顿一下，深呼吸，

sentences.en: and maybe even be explicit about whatever is going on for me as my internal processes.
sentences.zh: 甚至明确表达我当下的内心感受。

sentences.en: Whereas in the past, certainly as trainees, we would pause and dominate the conversation with, you know, fiddling around with a bottle of water and all of that.
sentences.zh: 而在过去，作为实习生，我们确实会通过摆弄水瓶来拖延时间，主导对话。

sentences.en: And we made a decision that we wouldn't do that.
sentences.zh: 我们当时决定不再那样做。

sentences.en: We wouldn't bring drinks to sessions or if we did, they'd stay under our chair so that we could try to stay as connected to the process as possible.
sentences.zh: 我们不会把饮料带到面试现场，或者如果带了，也会放在椅子下面，这样我们就能尽可能保持与面试过程的连接。

sentences.en: So just be mindful if you are wanting to hydrate yourself all the time mid-interview.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你在面试中总是想喝水，请务必留意这一点。

sentences.en: You know, it's OK to be nervous, you know, it matters.
sentences.zh: 紧张是很正常的，因为这真的很重要。

sentences.en: It's a big deal.
sentences.zh: 这可是件大事。

sentences.en: But, yeah, just think about how you're using your hydration to perhaps buy you time and just be consciously aware of that, I think.
sentences.zh: 但确实，试着想一想如何利用喝水来为你争取时间，并对此保持清醒的意识，我觉得这很有用。

sentences.en: And like I said, you know, it can be useful just to give yourself some breathing time to be able to slow down that tricky brain of ours and to be able to bring your A-game.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，给自己留点喘息的时间，好让咱们那颗爱乱想的大脑慢下来，从而发挥出最佳水平，这真的很有帮助。

sentences.en: You know, if our mind is racing, if our thoughts are whirring a thousand miles a minute, then we're not going to be able to think about what it is that we've got to do
sentences.zh: 要知道，如果我们的思绪乱飞，脑子里转得飞快，那我们就没法去思考自己到底该做什么，

sentences.en: and what we've got to answer.
sentences.zh: 以及该回答什么。

sentences.en: So just give yourself a pause, you know, take a breath before answering the question.
sentences.zh: 所以，在回答问题之前，给自己留个暂停，喝口水，深呼吸一下。

sentences.en: Really think about your options.
sentences.zh: 好好考虑一下你的选项。

sentences.en: And it's always OK to ask for the question again, especially if you've done a big waffle and you want to make sure you've covered it.
sentences.zh: 而且，要求对方重复一遍问题完全没问题，特别是当你已经说了一大堆废话，想确保自己确实回答到了点子上的时候。

sentences.en: So if you know any trainee psychologists at the moment or, you know, any qualified psychologists,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你现在认识任何实习心理学家，或者认识任何有资质的心理学家，

sentences.en: perhaps hopefully your supervisor, they might be willing to do a mock interview with you.
sentences.zh: 或许，希望是你的导师，他们可能愿意和你进行一次模拟面试。

sentences.en: And that can feel like a very cringeworthy exercise indeed.
sentences.zh: 这确实会让人觉得非常尴尬。

sentences.en: And I did that with my supervisor at the time who was a forensic psychologist and I was an aspiring clinical.
sentences.zh: 我当时就和我的导师做过这个练习，他是一位法医心理学家，而我当时还只是个想成为临床心理学家的实习生。

sentences.en: But it just helped me to get those crickets moments and, you know, all of the tumbleweed moments where I just felt like a, you know, pretend human,
sentences.zh: 但这确实帮我克服了那些冷场时刻，你知道的，就是那种尴尬到像有风滚草滚过的时刻，让我觉得自己像个假人，

sentences.en: let alone an aspiring trainee clinical psychologist out of the way.
sentences.zh: 更别提当时我还是个想成为临床心理学家的实习生了。

sentences.en: And, you know, just got me some of that ability to want to laugh at myself out the way because I did that in the relative safety of my supervision relationship.
sentences.zh: 而且，这让我学会了如何自嘲，因为我是在督导关系的相对安全环境下完成这些练习的。

sentences.en: So it can be really helpful to have, to have, yeah, to have that.
sentences.zh: 所以，能有这样的练习机会真的非常有帮助。

sentences.en: And just to have someone ask you questions in an interview setting and kind of be a bit more, you know, stony faced with you
sentences.zh: 找个人在面试场景下向你提问，并且表现得稍微严肃一点，

sentences.en: because that can be really useful to help you feel that pressure.
sentences.zh: 因为这对于让你感受那种压力真的很有用。

sentences.en: And then when you get to the actual interview experience, it feels less alien.
sentences.zh: 这样当你真正参加面试时，就不会感到那么陌生了。

sentences.en: And perhaps if you haven't been in your post that long or you feel like your relationship is not that great with your supervisor,
sentences.zh: 如果你入职不久，或者觉得和导师的关系没那么好，

sentences.en: then you might not want to admit that you're going for a new job.
sentences.zh: 那你可能不想承认自己正在找新工作。

sentences.en: So that might not always feel, you know, that approachable.
sentences.zh: 所以，这可能并不总是让你觉得那么容易开口。

sentences.en: But hopefully you might know someone who's got more experience with you than you.
sentences.zh: 但希望你能认识比你更有经验的人。

sentences.en: It might be a trainee or it might be, you know, someone who's already qualified, but not your supervisor.
sentences.zh: 可能是实习生，也可能是已经有资质的人，只要不是你的导师就行。

sentences.en: And they might be willing to at least have a look through your application and have a look through the job description
sentences.zh: 他们可能愿意至少帮你看看申请材料，看看职位描述，

sentences.en: to come up with some example questions that might be useful for you to consider.
sentences.zh: 然后想出一些值得你考虑的示例问题。

sentences.en: So I hope you found this really useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得这些内容很有用。

sentences.en: And there should be some time between when this episode goes live and when certainly the clinical application interview season comes to the fore.
sentences.zh: 从本期节目上线到临床申请面试季正式到来，应该还有一段时间。

sentences.en: So if there are any specific questions you've got, then do let me know through my contact details, of which you can find in the show notes and the links section.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你有任何具体问题，请通过节目说明和链接部分里的联系方式告诉我。

sentences.en: And I will, you know, really be really happy to help shape this.
sentences.zh: 我会非常乐意帮助你完善这些内容。

sentences.en: And yeah, thank you for listening.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家的收听。

sentences.en: I hope you find this useful and good luck with your interview.
sentences.zh: 希望这对你有帮助，祝你面试顺利。

sentences.en: Being well supported during any interview season is so important.
sentences.zh: 在面试季期间得到良好的支持非常重要。

sentences.en: I have therefore planned some compassionate question and answer support sessions for you.
sentences.zh: 因此，我为你策划了一些充满关怀的问答支持环节。

sentences.en: You are absolutely welcome to come along to all of them.
sentences.zh: 非常欢迎你参加所有的环节。

sentences.en: Some of them, none of them.
sentences.zh: 或者参加其中几个，甚至一个都不参加也没关系。

sentences.en: No need to book.
sentences.zh: 无需预约。

sentences.en: And here are the dates for you.
sentences.zh: 以下是具体日期。

sentences.en: Monday, the 28th of February from 7.30pm.
sentences.zh: 2月28日，星期一，晚上7点半。

sentences.en: Monday, the 21st of March, 7.30pm.
sentences.zh: 3月21日，星期一，晚上7点半。

sentences.en: Monday, the 4th of April, 7.30pm.
sentences.zh: 4月4日，星期一，晚上7点半。

sentences.en: And Monday, the 9th of May, 7.30pm.
sentences.zh: 5月9日，星期一，晚上7点半。

sentences.en: And they will all be live streaming via my socials, which includes Twitter, YouTube, LinkedIn and Facebook.
sentences.zh: 所有环节都将通过我的社交媒体进行直播，包括Twitter、YouTube、LinkedIn和Facebook。

sentences.en: So you can absolutely pick your favourite platform.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以完全选择你喜欢的平台。

sentences.en: And they'll all be available on replay as well.
sentences.zh: 这些直播也都会有回放。

sentences.en: Hope you find it so useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得这很有用。

sentences.en: And I will look forward to catching up with some of you then.
sentences.zh: 期待到时与你们交流。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间以外的钱，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家Marianne Trent博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One2Money programme is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote的One2Money项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员制服务和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己曾在2022年完成了这个项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的成长之路。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得Sophie提供的奖励，以及我提供的额外专属支持包，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场小组大师课、大师班、个性化指导、一份Fortnum and Mason礼品，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 详情请查看描述中链接的我的奖励页面。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。
